cite: packed from ROM-decoded logo rasters (scooby_lz): van banks @ROM 0x10B14 -> VRAM tile 0x458. Tiles extracted column-major and placed at the VRAM bases the menu SAT (ROM 0x0085F8) specifies. Referenced-but-unsourced tiles (the DOO logo's bottom 1632..1663) are transparent -- nothing in the ROM writes them, confirmed blank.
note: NOT byte-identical to the old capture (a mid-dissolve VRAM snapshot); this is the real logo tiles packed fresh. Atlas layout is our own -- vdp_screen.gd reads it via tiles_index, so layout is internal.
